title: DiffAuction: An Auction-Driven Framework for Generative Image Advertising
title_zh: DiffAuction：一个拍卖驱动的生成式图像广告框架

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models create an opportunity for advertising in generated visual content, with multiple advertisers competing for exposure within a shared image. Yet existing approaches are computationally costly when generating images under varying target-share configurations, and it remains unclear how the resulting outcomes should be evaluated and priced. To address these gaps, we propose DiffAuction, an auction framework connecting controllable generation, click-intent evaluation, and auction design. First, our training-free Residual Share Calibration (RSC) decomposes joint-attention updates into product-specific residuals and rescales them according to target shares. Because a fixed prompt tends to produce similar viewpoints that favor the same products regardless of their target shares, we further introduce Share-Conditioned Prompting (SCP) to adapt the viewpoint to each desired allocation. Second, we develop an evaluator that uses a VLM to extract visual evidence and an LLM to assess Click-Through Intent (CTI), a proxy for click propensity, along four dimensions: Product Prominence, Brand Recognizability, Scene Integration, and Contextual Value Communication. We validate its assessments against judgments from 10 trained annotators on 1,000 images. Third, we formulate this advertising setting as an auction over jointly feasible generation configurations. Each configuration has a public expected CTI vector, while advertisers hold configuration-specific private values per unit of CTI that map click intent into commercial value. We adopt a learnable affine maximizer auction (AMA), which jointly selects a shared generation configuration and determines advertiser-specific payments to maximize expected platform revenue. The resulting allocation and payment rules guarantee dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC) and individual rationality (IR). Experiments show that our generation method strengthens the monotonic relationship between target shares and CTI relative to baselines, while the learned AMA achieves higher platform revenue in the resulting auction setting.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models extend this opportunity to visual advertising, raising the possibility of advertisers competing for exposure within a shared generated image. Compared with LLM-based ad auctions, this direction remains underexplored. Designing such auctions requires addressing three interdependent challenges. First, the generation process should realize the advertiser exposure shares selected by the auction, yet diffusion models offer limited control over these shares through prompting alone. Second, the effectiveness of each advertiser’s exposure must be measurable. Click-through intent (CTI) provides a suitable criterion. Whereas conventional auctions can draw on historical click-through rates for pre-defined slots, each generated image is a new outcome whose product-level CTI must be estimated from its content. Third, the mechanism should combine the publicly known expected CTI with advertisers’ private values per CTI unit, select a jointly feasible exposure-share configuration, and determine bidder-specific payments that incentivize truthful reporting.

paragraphs.en: To address the first challenge, Sun et al. (2025) introduce bid-weighted score composition, combining multiple diffusion predictions, each conditioned on a distinct subset of product prompts. This requires multiple conditional model evaluations per timestep, increasing computational cost as the number of products grows. To accelerate generation, we condition the model jointly on all product prompts and incorporate the exposure-share specification within a single forward pass per timestep. We implement this using Residual Share Calibration (RSC), a training-free method that decomposes joint attention’s residual output into product-specific updates induced by the corresponding product tokens. These updates capture how each product shifts the latent image features during generation. RSC calibrates their magnitudes according to the target exposure shares. A fixed prompt can favor similar viewpoints even as target shares change, leaving certain products consistently obscured or overly prominent. We therefore introduce Share-Conditioned Prompting (SCP) that adjusts the viewing perspective according to target shares to better support the desired exposure allocation.

paragraphs.en: To address the second challenge, we introduce a product-level CTI proxy based on four interpretable dimensions: product prominence, brand recognizability, scene integration, and contextual value communication, with an analysis supporting their coverage of the principal aspects of CTI evaluation. We use a VLM to extract visual evidence for each product, and an LLM to score the evidence along each dimension using a fixed rubric. The aggregate score provides a content-based estimate of product-level click intent, which we use to evaluate the effectiveness of the realized exposure. We assess this evaluator on a dataset of 1,000 images annotated by ten annotators and find that its scores correlate strongly with human ratings.

paragraphs.en: To address the third challenge, we formulate exposure trading in generative image advertising as an auction over generation configurations subject to joint feasibility constraints. For a given scene and set of competing advertisers, the platform offers candidate generation configurations, each specifying an exposure share and an expected CTI for each advertiser. Moreover, different ad presentations may affect both click intent and the conversion potential of the resulting attention ( Schwartz et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Advertisers may thus value each unit of CTI differently across configurations based on their private conversion data and campaign objectives. We therefore allow each advertiser to hold multiple private valuations, one for each configuration. Building on this formulation, we adopt a learnable affine maximizer auction (AMA) ( Curry et al., 2023 ) to optimize expected platform revenue while ensuring truthful reporting. Using a joint scoring function with learnable advertiser weights and configuration-specific offsets, the mechanism selects the highest-scoring configuration and constructs advertiser-specific price menus that depend only on the other advertisers’ reports. We show that this allocation and payment rule make the selected configuration utility-maximizing for each advertiser within its own menu, and that this mechanism guarantees dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC) and individual rationality (IR).
paragraphs.zh: 为应对第三个挑战，我们将生成式图像广告中的曝光交易建模为在满足联合可行性约束下、针对生成配置的拍卖问题。 对于给定场景和一组相互竞争的广告主，平台提供候选生成配置，每个配置为各广告主指定一个曝光份额和一个预期 CTI。 此外，不同的广告呈现方式可能同时影响点击意图以及由此产生的注意力的转化潜力（Schwartz et al., 2017；Li et al., 2025）。 因此，广告主可能基于其私有转化数据和营销目标，对不同配置下的每一单位 CTI 赋予不同的价值。 因此，我们允许每个广告主持有多个私有估值，每个配置对应一个估值。 在此建模基础上，我们采用可学习的仿射最大化拍卖（AMA）（Curry et al., 2023），在确保真实申报的同时优化平台的期望收益。 该机制使用一个带有可学习广告主权重和配置特定偏移量的联合评分函数，选择得分最高的配置，并构建仅依赖于其他广告主申报的广告主专属价格菜单。 我们证明，这一分配与支付规则使得所选配置在各自菜单内对每个广告主都是效用最大化的，并且该机制保证了占优策略激励相容（DSIC）与个体理性（IR）。

sents.en: To address the third challenge, we formulate exposure trading in generative image advertising as an auction over generation configurations subject to joint feasibility constraints.
sents.zh: 为应对第三个挑战，我们将生成式图像广告中的曝光交易建模为在满足联合可行性约束下、针对生成配置的拍卖问题。

sents.en: For a given scene and set of competing advertisers, the platform offers candidate generation configurations, each specifying an exposure share and an expected CTI for each advertiser.
sents.zh: 对于给定场景和一组相互竞争的广告主，平台提供候选生成配置，每个配置为各广告主指定一个曝光份额和一个预期 CTI。

sents.en: Moreover, different ad presentations may affect both click intent and the conversion potential of the resulting attention ( Schwartz et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 此外，不同的广告呈现方式可能同时影响点击意图以及由此产生的注意力的转化潜力（Schwartz et al., 2017；Li et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Advertisers may thus value each unit of CTI differently across configurations based on their private conversion data and campaign objectives.
sents.zh: 因此，广告主可能基于其私有转化数据和营销目标，对不同配置下的每一单位 CTI 赋予不同的价值。

sents.en: We therefore allow each advertiser to hold multiple private valuations, one for each configuration.
sents.zh: 因此，我们允许每个广告主持有多个私有估值，每个配置对应一个估值。

sents.en: Building on this formulation, we adopt a learnable affine maximizer auction (AMA) ( Curry et al., 2023 ) to optimize expected platform revenue while ensuring truthful reporting.
sents.zh: 在此建模基础上，我们采用可学习的仿射最大化拍卖（AMA）（Curry et al., 2023），在确保真实申报的同时优化平台的期望收益。

sents.en: Using a joint scoring function with learnable advertiser weights and configuration-specific offsets, the mechanism selects the highest-scoring configuration and constructs advertiser-specific price menus that depend only on the other advertisers’ reports.
sents.zh: 该机制使用一个带有可学习广告主权重和配置特定偏移量的联合评分函数，选择得分最高的配置，并构建仅依赖于其他广告主申报的广告主专属价格菜单。

sents.en: We show that this allocation and payment rule make the selected configuration utility-maximizing for each advertiser within its own menu, and that this mechanism guarantees dominant-strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC) and individual rationality (IR).
sents.zh: 我们证明，这一分配与支付规则使得所选配置在各自菜单内对每个广告主都是效用最大化的，并且该机制保证了占优策略激励相容（DSIC）与个体理性（IR）。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments show that combining RSC with SCP reduces generation time while strengthening the monotonic relationship between target exposure shares and product-level CTI. Our CTI evaluation also exhibits relatively high agreement with human annotations. Finally, experiments with simulated private valuations demonstrate that the learned AMA achieves higher platform revenue than the baselines in this auction setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验表明，将 RSC 与 SCP 相结合可以缩短生成时间，同时强化目标曝光份额与产品级 CTI 之间的单调关系。 我们的 CTI 评估与人工标注也表现出较高的一致性。 最后，使用模拟私有估值的实验表明，在该拍卖设定下，学习到的 AMA 相比基线方法能带来更高的平台收入。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold:
paragraphs.zh: 总之，我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: We propose a training-free method combining RSC and SCP to control product exposure in generated images according to target shares.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种无需训练的方法，结合 RSC 与 SCP，根据目标份额来控制生成图像中的产品曝光。

paragraphs.en: We develop a VLM–LLM evaluator that assesses product-level CTI along four interpretable dimensions and construct a dataset of 1,000 images annotated by 10 annotators to evaluate its agreement with human judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个 VLM–LLM 评估器，沿四个可解释的维度评估产品级 CTI，并构建了一个由 10 名标注者标注的 1,000 张图像的数据集，以评估其与人类判断的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We formulate generative image advertising as an auction over jointly feasible generation configurations with multiple configuration-specific private values per CTI unit. We instantiate this formulation with a learnable affine maximizer auction (AMA) that optimizes expected platform revenue while guaranteeing DSIC and IR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将生成式图像广告建模为一个拍卖问题，其标的是联合可行的生成配置，每个 CTI 单位具有多个特定于配置的私有估值。 我们用一种可学习的仿射最大化拍卖（AMA）来实例化这一建模，该拍卖在保证 DSIC 与 IR 的同时优化平台的期望收入。

paragraphs.en: Generative advertising treats model-generated content as advertising inventory, allowing advertisers to bid for influence beyond predefined ad slots. Existing LLM-native mechanisms realize this idea at different levels: token-level auctions allow bids to influence individual tokens ( Duetting et al., 2024 ) ; RAG-based segment auctions allocate ads to discourse segments according to bids and relevance ( Hajiaghayi et al., 2024 ) ; MOSAIC aggregates advertisers’ preferences over generated responses without fine-tuning the LLM ( Soumalias et al., 2025 ) ; and LLM-Auction jointly models auction allocation and response generation ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Neuron Auctions shift the auction object from surface text to internal FFN representations and treat continuous intervention budgets as auctionable commodities ( Yun et al., 2026 ) . These studies motivate our formulation of product exposure in a generated image as an auctionable resource.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式广告将模型生成的内容视为广告库存，允许广告主竞标以在预定义广告位之外施加影响。 现有的 LLM 原生机制在不同层面实现了这一理念：token 级拍卖允许出价影响单个 token（Duetting et al., 2024）；基于 RAG 的片段拍卖根据出价和相关性将广告分配到话语片段（Hajiaghayi et al., 2024）；MOSAIC 在不微调 LLM 的情况下聚合广告主对生成回复的偏好（Soumalias et al., 2025）；LLM-Auction 则联合建模拍卖分配与回复生成（Zhao et al., 2025）。 神经元拍卖将拍卖对象从表面文本转移到内部 FFN 表示，并将连续的干预预算视为可拍卖的商品（Yun et al., 2026）。 这些研究启发我们将生成图像中的产品曝光表述为一种可拍卖的资源。

paragraphs.en: However, auction-driven generative image advertising remains relatively underexplored. Sun et al. (2025) provide an initial study. Their target-share-conditioned generation requires multiple conditional model evaluations per denoising timestep, causing computational cost to grow with the number of products. Moreover, they use CLIP similarity as a proxy for product value, but this simple proxy lacks interpretability and direct validation. They also do not consider the more complex setting in which advertisers hold multiple configuration-specific private valuations, or integrate image generation and auction design into a unified framework for optimizing platform revenue. Therefore, systematic work is still needed to fill these research gaps.

paragraphs.en: A broad line of research controls pretrained diffusion models at inference time without additional model training. Existing approaches intervene at different stages of the generation process. Attention-based methods manipulate token–image interactions to preserve, amplify, or suppress specific concepts; for example, Prompt-to-Prompt edits cross-attention maps and supports token-level attention reweighting ( Hertz et al., 2022 ) , while Rich Text introduces explicit token and region-aware guidance ( Ge et al., 2023 ) . Guidance-based approaches modify denoising directions to strengthen or suppress semantic concepts, as exemplified by SEGA ( Brack et al., 2023 ) . More recent methods directly edit internal representations of diffusion Transformers; FluxSpace, for instance, identifies editable directions in FLUX feature spaces ( Dalva et al., 2025 ) . These methods demonstrate the effectiveness of inference-time intervention for semantic and compositional control. However, our setting differs from conventional concept editing: multiple advertised products coexist in the same jointly generated scene, and the objective is not merely to include or emphasize a concept, but to regulate their relative exposure according to a prescribed share vector. Sun et al. (2025) address this problem by combining generation directions obtained from multiple conditional model evaluations, resulting in increased computational cost as the number of products grows. In contrast, the combination of Share-Conditioned Prompting (SCP) and Residual Share Calibration (RSC) supports target-share-conditioned generation with only a single model forward pass per denoising timestep.
paragraphs.zh: 大量研究工作在不进行额外模型训练的情况下，在推理阶段控制预训练扩散模型。 现有方法在生成过程的不同阶段进行干预。 基于注意力的方法操纵词元与图像之间的交互，以保留、放大或抑制特定概念；例如，Prompt-to-Prompt 编辑交叉注意力图并支持词元级别的注意力重加权（Hertz et al., 2022），而 Rich Text 引入了显式的词元与区域感知引导（Ge et al., 2023）。 基于引导的方法修改去噪方向以强化或抑制语义概念，SEGA 是其中的典型代表（Brack et al., 2023）。 更新的方法直接编辑扩散Transformer的内部表示；例如，FluxSpace 在 FLUX 特征空间中识别可编辑方向（Dalva et al., 2025）。 这些方法证明了推理时干预在语义与组合控制方面的有效性。 然而，我们的设定不同于传统的概念编辑：多个被推广的产品共存于同一个联合生成的场景中，目标不仅是包含或强调某个概念，而是按照规定的份额向量来调节它们的相对曝光度。Sun 等人 （2025）通过组合从多次条件模型评估中获得的生成方向来解决这一问题，随着产品数量的增加，计算成本也随之上升。 相比之下，份额条件提示（SCP）与残差份额校准（RSC）的结合，只需在每个去噪时间步进行一次模型前向传播，即可支持目标份额条件化的生成。

paragraphs.en: We focus on image-observable factors that may influence CTI while abstracting away subjective product preferences. We define four complementary dimensions: product prominence , which captures visual salience; brand recognizability , which reflects the visibility of brand cues; scene integration , which measures how naturally the product fits into the scene; and contextual value communication , which assesses whether the scene conveys the product’s use, relevance, or value. Appendix F provides further details, including an analysis of the completeness of these dimensions for CTI evaluation.

paragraphs.en: We formulate exposure trading as an auction over generation configurations subject to joint feasibility constraints. We adopt a learnable affine maximizer auction (AMA) ( Curry et al., 2023 ) to optimize expected platform revenue, the payments from advertisers. The mechanism selects a single common configuration using learnable advertiser weights and configuration offsets and determines advertiser-specific payments according to the affine-maximizer payment rule.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将曝光交易建模为在联合可行性约束下对生成配置进行的拍卖。 我们采用可学习的仿射最大化拍卖（AMA）（Curry et al., 2023）来优化平台的期望收入，即来自广告主的付款。 该机制使用可学习的广告主权重和配置偏移量来选择单一公共配置，并根据仿射最大化付款规则确定各广告主的付款。

paragraphs.en: Effective exposure control should translate higher target shares into more effective exposure in generated images, as measured by CTI. A stronger monotonic relationship therefore indicates that the generation method more consistently realizes the intended allocation. Therefore, we evaluate this relationship on 1,000 two-product scenes covering 400 distinct products, generating each scene under 19 share configurations for a total of 19,000 images. For our method, we use FLUX.1-schnell to generate images at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution with 10 denoising steps, applying RSC during the first 8 steps. We compare against Sun et al. (2025) , which weights separately computed generation directions by bids, and prompt-only FLUX, which specifies exposure shares directly in the prompt. Our method performs best across all five metrics (Table 1 ), whose definitions are provided in Appendix B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 有效的曝光控制应当使更高的目标份额转化为生成图像中更高的实际曝光，以 CTI 来衡量。 因此，更强的单调关系表明生成方法能够更一致地实现预期的分配。 为此，我们在涵盖 400 种不同产品的 1,000 个双产品场景上评估这一关系，在每个场景下使用 19 种份额配置生成图像，共生成 19,000 张图像。 对于我们的方法，我们使用 FLUX.1-schnell 以 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 的分辨率生成图像，采用 10 步去噪，并在前 8 步中应用 RSC。 我们与 Sun 等人 (2025) 进行比较，该方法按出价对分别计算得到的生成方向进行加权；同时与仅使用提示词的 FLUX 进行比较，后者直接在提示词中指定曝光份额。 我们的方法在全部五项指标上表现最佳（表 1），各指标的定义见附录 B.2。

paragraphs.en: We recruited 10 trained annotators to evaluate 1,000 generated images using the same four-dimensional rubric as our CTI evaluator, with each annotator rating 100 images. Product order was randomized, and target exposure shares were hidden. Annotators scored each product based on the generated image, product descriptions, and scene context. Using these human annotations as a reference, we compare two evaluation pipelines: VLM, which directly scores images with InternVL3-14B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , and VLM–LLM, which uses InternVL3-14B to extract visual evidence and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) to score it. paragraphs.en: We presented DiffAuction, a unified framework integrating controllable image generation, CTI evaluation, and truthful auction design. RSC and SCP enable continuous exposure control with one model forward pass per denoising step, while the CTI evaluator provides interpretable product-level click-intent estimates. A learnable affine maximizer combines expected CTI with advertisers’ private values to select feasible configurations and determine payments while ensuring DSIC and IR. Experiments demonstrate improved share–CTI monotonicity, generation efficiency, human agreement, and auction revenue.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DiffAuction，一个整合可控图像生成、CTI 评估与真实拍卖设计的统一框架。 RSC 与 SCP 实现了连续曝光控制，每个去噪步骤仅需一次模型前向传播，同时 CTI 评估器提供可解释的商品级点击意图估计。 一个可学习的仿射最大化器将期望 CTI 与广告主的私有价值相结合，以选择可行的配置并确定支付，同时确保 DSIC 与 IR。 实验表明，该方法在份额–CTI 单调性、生成效率、人工一致性以及拍卖收入方面均有提升。

paragraphs.en: We vary the number of denoising steps during which RSC is applied to study the trade-off between control effectiveness and computational cost. For each setting, we report the monotonicity between the target exposure share and CTI. As shown in Table 10 , increasing the control duration from two to eight steps consistently improves all five metrics, indicating that sustained residual calibration strengthens share–CTI monotonicity over the evaluated configurations. The best performance is obtained with eight controlled steps. Extending RSC to all ten denoising steps leads to a slight degradation, suggesting that intervention during the final refinement stage may over-constrain local appearance and disrupt the previously established prominence ordering. Therefore, controlling the first eight steps provides the best balance between monotonicity and computational overhead.

paragraphs.en: We further investigate where RSC should be applied within FLUX. We first define the scope of factors considered in our framework, then identify two complementary evaluation perspectives within this scope and further divide each perspective into two categories, forming a 2 × 2 2\times 2 conceptual space. paragraphs.en: We focus on evaluation factors tailored to AIGC-based product placement rather than directly adopting criteria from conventional advertising evaluation. Specifically, we consider factors that are relevant to embedded product advertising and can be reliably assessed from generated images. Highly subjective or abstract judgments, such as overall aesthetics or generic attractiveness, are excluded because they are difficult to define consistently and to evaluate robustly with automated models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们专注于针对基于AIGC的产品植入的评估因素，而不是直接沿用传统广告评估的标准。 具体而言，我们考虑与嵌入式产品广告相关且能够从生成图像中可靠评估的因素。 高度主观或抽象的判断，例如整体美感或一般吸引力，被排除在外，因为它们难以被一致地定义，也难以用自动化模型进行稳健的评估。

paragraphs.en: We adopt the logic of conceptual typology , which organizes a complex construct through multiple dimensions and their combinations into a structured property space ( Collier et al., 2012 ) . Following this methodology, we characterize placement-specific influencing factors from two complementary perspectives: Stimulus and Processing . This choice is grounded in classical advertising information-processing theory, which distinguishes the advertising stimuli or executional cues presented to consumers from the subsequent processing through which these stimuli influence consumer responses ( MacInnis and Jaworski, 1989 ; MacInnis et al., 1991 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用概念类型学的逻辑，通过多个维度及其组合将一个复杂构念组织成一个结构化的属性空间（Collier 等，2012）。 遵循这一方法论，我们从两个互补的视角刻画广告位特定的影响因素：刺激（Stimulus）与加工（Processing）。 这一选择植根于经典的广告信息加工理论，该理论将呈现给消费者的广告刺激或执行线索与后续的加工过程区分开来，正是通过这一加工过程，这些刺激影响消费者反应（MacInnis 和 Jaworski，1989；MacInnis 等，1991）。

paragraphs.en: In our framework, Stimulus refers to the visual advertising content from which a placement-specific influence originates. We divide this dimension into the inserted product itself and the relation between the product and its surrounding scene. This distinction is supported by established structural and advertising theories: the Entity–Relationship model treats entities and their relationships as different primitives ( Chen, 1976 ) , scene-graph representations similarly separate objects, object attributes, and inter-object relationships in visual scenes ( Johnson et al., 2015 ; Krishna et al., 2017 ) , and product-placement research further shows that how a brand is presented and how it is connected to host content can have different effects on brand memory and attitude ( Russell, 2002 ) . Together, these findings support treating product properties and product–scene relational properties as two distinct sources of placement-specific visual influence.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的框架中，刺激指的是产生特定于植入物影响的视觉广告内容。 我们将这一维度划分为插入的产品本身，以及产品与其周围场景之间的关系。 这一划分得到了成熟的结构理论与广告理论的支持：实体—关系模型将实体及其关系视为不同的基本要素（ Chen, 1976 ） ，场景图表示方法同样在视觉场景中将对象、对象属性以及对象间关系分开表示（ Johnson et al., 2015 ; Krishna et al., 2017 ） ，而产品植入研究进一步表明，品牌呈现的方式以及品牌与宿主内容关联的方式，对品牌记忆和品牌态度可能产生不同的影响（ Russell, 2002 ） 。 综合来看，这些发现支持将产品属性与产品—场景关系属性视为特定于植入物视觉影响的两个不同来源。

sents.en: In our framework, Stimulus refers to the visual advertising content from which a placement-specific influence originates.
sents.zh: 在我们的框架中，刺激指的是产生特定于植入物影响的视觉广告内容。

sents.en: We divide this dimension into the inserted product itself and the relation between the product and its surrounding scene.
sents.zh: 我们将这一维度划分为插入的产品本身，以及产品与其周围场景之间的关系。

sents.zh: 综合来看，这些发现支持将产品属性与产品—场景关系属性视为特定于植入物视觉影响的两个不同来源。

paragraphs.en: Other visual elements are outside our research scope unless they interact with the inserted product; such effects are subsumed under the Product–Scene Relation category.
paragraphs.zh: 其他视觉元素不在我们的研究范围内，除非它们与植入的产品产生交互；此类效应被归入「产品–场景关系」类别。

paragraphs.en: In our framework, Processing describes how visual advertising content is interpreted by consumers. We distinguish between Explicit processing, which relies primarily on directly observable visual configurations such as product size, position, and color, and Implicit processing, which requires further interpretation to derive higher-level commercial meanings such as brand identity, product functionality, and perceived value.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的框架中，Processing（加工）描述的是消费者如何解读视觉广告内容。 我们区分了显性加工（Explicit processing）与隐性加工（Implicit processing）：显性加工主要依赖于可直接观察的视觉配置，如产品尺寸、位置和颜色；隐性加工则需要进一步的解读才能得出更高层次的商业含义，如品牌形象、产品功能和感知价值。

sents.en: In our framework, Processing describes how visual advertising content is interpreted by consumers.
sents.zh: 在我们的框架中，Processing（加工）描述的是消费者如何解读视觉广告内容。

sents.en: We distinguish between Explicit processing, which relies primarily on directly observable visual configurations such as product size, position, and color, and Implicit processing, which requires further interpretation to derive higher-level commercial meanings such as brand identity, product functionality, and perceived value.
sents.zh: 我们区分了显性加工（Explicit processing）与隐性加工（Implicit processing）：显性加工主要依赖于可直接观察的视觉配置，如产品尺寸、位置和颜色；隐性加工则需要进一步的解读才能得出更高层次的商业含义，如品牌形象、产品功能和感知价值。

paragraphs.en: This distinction is supported by advertising and consumer-processing theories: Scott (1994) characterizes advertising images as symbolic systems capable of conveying meanings beyond their literal appearance; visual-rhetoric research further shows that consumers construct higher-level meanings from visual configurations ( McQuarrie and Mick, 1999 ) ; and means–end theory describes a progression from concrete product attributes to increasingly abstract consequences and values ( Reynolds et al., 1995 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这一区分得到了广告与消费者加工理论的支持：Scott（1994）将广告图像刻画为一种符号系统，能够传达超越其字面外观的意义；视觉修辞研究进一步表明，消费者会从视觉构型中构建更高层次的意义（McQuarrie and Mick, 1999）；而手段—目的理论则描述了从具体的产品属性到日益抽象的结果与价值的递进过程（Reynolds et al., 1995）。

paragraphs.en: Crossing the two dimensions yields four conceptual cells, each corresponding to a distinct source and mode of placement-specific influence. We instantiate these cells with four evaluation dimensions, as summarized in Table 14 .
paragraphs.zh: 将这两个维度交叉可得四个概念单元格，每个单元格对应一种独特的场所特定影响的来源与模式。 我们用四个评估维度来实例化这些单元格，如表 14 所总结。

sents.en: We instantiate these cells with four evaluation dimensions, as summarized in Table 14 .

paragraphs.en: Product Prominence corresponds to the Product × \times Explicit cell because it measures the directly observable visual presence of the inserted product, reflected by factors such as its size, position, and color.
paragraphs.zh: 产品显著性对应于“产品 × \times 显式”这一单元格，因为它衡量的是被植入产品可直接观察到的视觉存在感，其体现因素包括产品的尺寸、位置和颜色。

paragraphs.en: Brand Recognizability represents the Product × \times Implicit cell. Although brand cues are physically present on the product, their commercial meaning emerges only when visual features such as logos, text, colors, or distinctive product designs are interpreted as a particular brand identity.
paragraphs.zh: 品牌可识别性对应于「产品 × 隐性」这一单元格。 尽管品牌线索在实体上存在于产品之中，但只有当徽标、文字、颜色或独特的产品设计等视觉特征被解读为某一特定品牌身份时，其商业意义才会显现出来。

paragraphs.en: Scene Integration corresponds to the Product–Scene Relation × \times Explicit cell because it evaluates directly observable compatibility between the product and its surrounding scene, including perspective, scale, illumination, contact, and occlusion.
paragraphs.zh: 场景整合对应于「产品–场景关系 × \times 显式」这一单元格，因为它评估的是产品与其周围场景之间可直接观察到的兼容性，包括透视、尺度、光照、接触与遮挡。

paragraphs.en: Contextual Value Communication represents the Product–Scene Relation × \times Implicit cell. It captures whether the relationship between the product and its context conveys higher-level commercial meanings, such as product usage, functional benefits, lifestyle associations, or perceived value.
paragraphs.zh: 情境价值传达对应「产品—场景关系 × 隐性」这一单元格。 它考察产品与其情境之间的关系是否传达了更高层次的商业含义，例如产品使用方式、功能性利益、生活方式联想或感知价值。

sents.zh: 情境价值传达对应「产品—场景关系 × 隐性」这一单元格。

sents.en: It captures whether the relationship between the product and its context conveys higher-level commercial meanings, such as product usage, functional benefits, lifestyle associations, or perceived value.

paragraphs.en: We do not claim that the four metrics constitute all determinants of click-through intent, nor that they exhaust every possible property within their corresponding cells. Rather, our completeness claim concerns the placement-specific conceptual space defined above. Within this space, many plausible alternative metrics substantially overlap with the four selected constructs, while others fall outside our scope because they are either not particularly salient to AIGC product placement or cannot be evaluated reliably from generated images by automated models. The four metrics therefore provide compact and operationalizable coverage of the major conceptual aspects relevant to our setting.

paragraphs.en: To assess the conceptual completeness of the four metrics within the scope of this study, we examine whether any candidate criterion satisfies both of the following conditions: (i) it falls within our scope of evaluating product placement in generated images; and (ii) its primary evaluation content or focus differs substantially from those of the four existing metrics, warranting its inclusion as a separate dimension.
